summary: Nomadar Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Remunerated Private Investment Agreement with Make A Mark Events SRL and Make Mark, LLC. Nomadar provided $1,000,000 for an advertising campaign, repayable within 30 days with a 2.7% return per 30-day period, renewable up to one year. The agreement is guaranteed by client contracts and the investor. No special situation is present; this is a short-term investment arrangement, not an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The terms are commercial, not transformative.
